title: Count Zero-Sum Subarrays
statement:
Given an array of integers, count the number of contiguous subarrays whose elements sum to zero.

A subarray is a contiguous portion of the array. Two subarrays are different if they start or end at different indices.
inputFormat:
The first line contains N.
The second line contains N space-separated integers.
outputFormat: A single integer: the count of subarrays with sum equal to zero.

examples.explanation: There are 5 subarrays that sum to zero.
The single-element subarray [0] sums to zero.

n = int(input())
